name: negate_2
notes: P6b6f29d9b9 G4 (verifier v1). Printed: 'Counter target noncreature spell.' Seat 0 casts Bear Cub (a creature spell); seat 1 holds Negate and {1}{U}, but a creature spell is no legal target, so seat 1 is never offered a counter: the Cub resolves and Negate stays in hand. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone; the counterspell cannot be cast at this spell (an illegal target), where the window never offered it.
